# Yahor Darashkevich

## Positioning
Customer Experience and Support Operations executive for high-growth SaaS, eCommerce, subscription, nutrition, and technology companies. Designs CX operating systems that connect support operations, Zendesk, AI self-service, Voice of Customer, and executive decision-making—so customer support is a strategic retention and trust engine, not only a cost center.

## Summary
15+ years building and scaling support organizations. Most recent chapter: Sr. Director of Customer Support at Ka'Chava—scaled from 1 agent to 95+ at peak, led 1.5M+ resolved tickets, held 89%+ CSAT, and kept first reply under 4 hours while managing two BPO partners and rolling out Zendesk Advanced AI agents that fully resolve 45% of chats, and growing.

## Canonical Site
- https://darashkevich.com/

## Key Outcomes
- 15+ years CX / support operations leadership
- 95+ agents scaled at peak growth (Ka'Chava)
- 1.5M+ customer tickets resolved
- 35K tickets/month at peak volume
- 89%+ CSAT maintained under sustained volume
- Under 4 hours first reply time
- 45% of chats fully resolved by Zendesk Advanced AI agents, and growing
- 2 BPO partnerships managed with shared QA and SLA visibility

## Services
- Customer Operations Strategy — org design, KPIs, escalation, cross-functional CX alignment
- AI, Self-Service & Support Automation — AI agent strategy, knowledge for humans and bots, guardrails, deflection metrics
- Support Team Scaling & Workforce Design — hiring, coverage models, QA, launch/spike readiness
- Zendesk & CX Systems Optimization — workflows, Explore reporting, help centers, integrations
- Voice of Customer & Customer Insight — sentiment trends, retention signals, executive insight reporting
- Vendor / BPO Performance Management — selection, onboarding, SLA/CSAT accountability
